name: OpenNext for Cloudflare Open-Source Adapter
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source adapter that builds Next.js applications for the Cloudflare Workers runtime; free to install and use locally without an adapter subscription.
watch_out: This is build/deployment tooling, NOT free Cloudflare hosting or unlimited Workers requests. Cloudflare Workers accounts, compute, bandwidth, storage and paid overages are governed by separate Cloudflare plans; retain MIT license notice.
